messages:
marta_finance: FYI — NorthPoint submitted a backdated credit request for Feb channel invoices. They swapped to a partner tier SKU on 2026-02-12 but our marketplace metering didn't map the new SKU so their usage was under-credited.

sam_sales: How big is the request? any supporting docs?

marta_finance: $12,450 (invoice 45321). I attached the CSV with line-level meter rows. Partner wants it credited. They also asked that the tier history be corrected so future invoices reflect the correct rebate.

priya_fp&a: Need GL and accounting path. Standalone credit note or apply to next invoice?

marta_finance: Prefer standalone credit note so ARR/recognition reconciles, but partner would accept it on the next invoice to avoid immediate cash action.

jules_revops: I can approve up to $5k. >5k needs RevOps + Legal + CFO FYI. Also confirm rebate tier change effective date.

marta_finance: Noted. Billing system can't auto-backfill mid-month tier changes. We'll need a manual ledger adj after engineering remaps the meter rows. @billing-bot please open an internal ticket for a meter remap and include the attached CSV.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-890 — "Azure marketplace: remap NorthPoint meter rows (Feb 2026)". ETA 3 business days. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-890

sam_sales: Partner okay with next invoice application if we also correct the tier history. Can RevOps confirm whether partial credit is an option?

jules_revops: Partial credit is possible but prefer full credit then reconcile within partner rebate ledger. I'll draft the approval memo and loop legal (cc: @laura_legal).

laura_legal: Received. I'll review the partner agreement for retro-credit clauses. If nothing prohibits, we usually require a signed amendment for retro changes >$10k.

priya_fp&a: Accounting inputs: GL 4302 (Customer Credits — Marketplace), cost_center: partners. Tag the credit as "backdated channel tier adjustment". Also need tax treatment confirmation from tax team.

marta_finance: Request exceeds $10k (12,450) — routing for CFO FYI. @cfo_troy

cfo_troy: FYI ok to proceed pending legal sign-off and confirmation of meter remap. Please confirm expected P&L hit and whether this should be treated as contra-revenue or exceptional item.

marta_finance: Will post as contra-revenue under GL 4302. I'll include draft journal entry and the CSV once BILL-890 is done. Next steps: wait for BILL-890, RevOps approval doc, legal sign-off/signature, then issue standalone credit note to be applied on Apr invoice unless partner specifically requests next invoice.

sam_sales: I'll coordinate signature with NorthPoint and update the thread when executed.

jules_revops: I'll upload the approval memo to the ticket and cc finance and legal.

marta_finance: Thanks — I'll hold the manual ledger entry until billing team confirms remap. Tracking note: internal owner = marta_finance, external owner = sam_sales. :white_check_mark:
